help:
usage: kn [-h] [--json]
          {info,contract,db,identity,review,lineage,source,space,vocabulary}
          ...

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                emit machine-readable JSON with stable keys

commands:
  {info,contract,db,identity,review,lineage,source,space,vocabulary}
    info                show the installed project identity
    contract            validate or compile open data contracts
    db                  apply or verify governed schema revisions
    identity            inspect and review object identity
    review              list and decide review items
    lineage             trace an object or field to its records and decisions
    source              list and validate sources
    space               space-domain datasets
    vocabulary          review and export controlled vocabularies
nested_help:
usage: kn space satcom [-h] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] {validate,import} source

arguments:
  {validate,import}
  source               source package directory

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --data-dir DATA_DIR  runtime data directory
